analysis.across_donor: Within each duration, mean donor-level effects with equal donor weights; never pool durations.
analysis.interpretation: Directional association within admitted units; no causal or age-restoration conclusion.
analysis.primary_output: Every admitted pair-level signed effect with donor, duration and experiment labels. Zero denotes no observed signed difference, not equivalence or statistical absence.
analysis.sensitivity: For each duration with at least two admitted donors, leave out each donor and recompute the mean and remaining donor count. One-donor sensitivity is unavailable.
analysis.uncertainty: Report pair/donor spread, coverage and donor sensitivity. No population confidence interval, significance test, pooled RNA-library correlation or clinical effect estimate.
analysis.within_donor: Within each donor and duration, mean pair deltas over admitted experiments with equal pair weights.

eligibility: The 13 frozen within-RNA negative-control versus transiently-reprogrammed final-outgrowth contrasts. Account for every frozen pair; no outcome-selected subset.

evidence_review.meaning: Software validates declared curation and file integrity; human review must establish that the sources support the mapping, values and reuse.

known_outcome_status: Known-outcome reanalysis challenge: Gill et al. already report variable migration and lack of apparent clock correlation. This freeze precedes new numerical intake, not knowledge of the published result.
limits: No rejuvenation, identity-retention, safety, persistence, ocular-efficacy, clinical or wet-lab-replacement conclusion.
Phase 483 and prior controller verdicts remain unchanged.
No new send, experiment or paid compute authorized by this contract.

primary_function.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of all eligible technical-replicate speeds within each mapped culture. Pre-aggregated summaries require a new contract revision.
primary_function.input: Original per-technical-replicate speed estimates with source IDs and exclusions. Image fields and fitted time points are not extra biological replicates.
primary_function.missing_rule: Defer; no function inferred from RNA, collagen, group means or a plot.

primary_molecular.input: Existing investigator-reported per-RNA-sample predicted age, in years, with exact RNA IDs and provenance. Source-reported readout; independent clock reproduction remains separate.
primary_molecular.missing_rule: Defer; no replacement clock, retraining, plot digitization or imputed age.

question: Within authoritatively matched final-outgrowth cultures, how do source-reported transcription-age differences compare with migration-speed differences?
stop_rules: Contradictory context/ID, duplicated observation, reused culture, non-finite value, incompatible unit, wrong clock, absent provenance or unreviewed permission defers all calculation.
Missing pairs require source-backed reasons; report coverage of all 13 contrasts.
New measurements, clocks, selection or complex replicate designs require a new dated contract; preserve this freeze.

unit_policy.claim_scope: Parent/sibling-culture comparison; destructive RNA assays supply no same-cell continuity.
unit_policy.reuse_rule: One RNA sample per function culture; one occurrence per technical observation ID. Complex designs require an amendment.
